method: Read original raster intake/clue/map pages and current source intake. Transcribe boundaries and all blocked markers from unsolved maps. Enumerate all distinct-row/column witness assignments from literal clues. Expected solution roster is stored only for post-enumeration comparison; no source solution fact injected into domains. Actual solved map inspected only for final comparison.

intro_case01.geometry: Delivery is entire D column. No blocked interior cells. Archive A1:B2; Library A3:B4; Workshop C1:C4. All six clues together force the complete roster.

case29.room_companion: Seth B1 and Vega D3 are the sole Equipment Hall occupants. Service Corridor has Jules E8 and Bryn G9. Training Room has Mavis A2/Poppy C6. Control Room Ren H5/Cato I4. Operations Office Wade F7.
case29.adjacency_sensitivity: Both edge-only and eight-neighbour beside yield exactly the same unique complete assignment. Jules diagonally next to Wade means both coordinate differences exactly one.
case29.direction_convention: North-west/north-east interpreted as strict column and row inequality at arbitrary distances, consistent with wording that separately specifies diagonally next. Forcing all compass relations onto 45-degree rays yields zero solutions; this artificial tighter convention is not silently assumed. In the accepted source roster Mavis A2 is northwest of Vega D3 despite unequal horizontal/vertical distances.
case29.story_context: Page132 calls Seth certain but supplies no visible coordinate. No assumed Seth coordinate was used; B1 is derived by elimination. All source objective constraints included.
case29.grid_details: 9x9,13 blocked cells. Black-square marked water-refill D9 and bin E9 included under general map key despite not individually named in blocked key.

reproduction.renders: PyMuPDF original[folio-1].get_pixmap(matrix=fitz.Matrix(2,2)); selected reproducible PNG hashes recorded below, PNGs need not be committed.

scope_limit: Independent geometry/logic check of Case01 andCase29 only; not a full illustrated candidate proof, print proof, source freeze or release approval.
